Class ScriptSimulation.GeoGrid

java.lang.Object
com.eco.bio7.compile.Model
com.eco.bio7.simulation.Simulation
com.eco.bio7.simulation.GridModel
com.eco.bio7.simulation.GeoGridModel
com.eco.bio7.simulation.ScriptSimulation.GeoGrid
All Implemented Interfaces:
ScriptSimulation.Host
Enclosing class:
ScriptSimulation
public static final class ScriptSimulation.GeoGrid extends GeoGridModel implements ScriptSimulation.Host
A geospatial grid of a script (the data is loaded by load() of the script with the GDAL of Bio7).
